before.exam_tip_html: When a question asks you to ‘suggest a solution to a barrier’, make sure your solution directly addresses the barrier you named — not just any barrier. For example, if the barrier is ‘lack of transport’, a relevant solution is ‘a club minibus scheme’; saying ‘build more facilities’ would not directly remove the transport barrier and will not score. For ‘discuss’ questions, consider two or more user groups or two or more barriers — examiners reward answers that consider more than one viewpoint.
